About.description:
The plain-language card of one catalog item.

Every field except the expert ones is required, so an About that validates is
structurally complete; :func:`about_issues` adds the editorial rules (one or two
sentences, no jargon in the summary, known chooser tags, related ids that exist).

assumptions: Numbers can be added up (spend, sales); averages are averaged
avoid_when: Your data already has one row per week
examples.example: Daily TV spend of 100 each day becomes 700 for the week.
outputs: The same columns, one row per week
examples.summary_plain: Adds up daily numbers into one number per week (or month), so that every row covers the same length of time.
examples.title: Weekly totals
use_when: Your data is daily but you want to plan or report by week

expert_notes.description: Maths, estimator details, caveats for experts
expert_notes.title: Expert Notes

fits.description: Chooser tags: question id -> the answers this item suits
fits.title: Fits

related.description: Ids of related catalog items (models, steps, nodes, checks, templates)
related.title: Related

summary_plain.description: One or two sentences without jargon: what it does for you
summary_plain.title: Summary Plain

About.title: About

conditions_on_actuals.description: A forecast can be conditioned on actuals sent with the request (target values for periods after, or at the end of, the fitted history): the model updates its state with them without re-estimating its parameters and forecasts from the last actual (mapi_spec.actuals). Models without it refuse such requests with ACTUALS_NOT_SUPPORTED instead of ignoring the actuals
conditions_on_actuals.title: Conditions On Actuals

input.title: Input

DataSchemaTemplate.description:
A DataSchema-shaped JSON template plus the settings parameters it depends on.

Resolution is pure and static: ``resolve(settings)`` extracts each declared parameter
from the settings (falling back to its default), checks its type/enum, renders the
:mod:`~mapi_spec.template` placeholders, deep-merges every matching ``case`` and
validates the result as a :class:`DataSchema`.
DataSchemaTemplate.title: DataSchemaTemplate

GridDecl.description:
How to draw an output as a 2-D field (an image, a map, a vector field).

``y`` and ``x`` are the dims of the raster rows and columns; ``y`` runs top to bottom
unless ``origin`` is ``lower``. ``frame`` names a third dim with one raster per level
(years, eras, times); ``component`` names a dim of length two that holds the ``(x, y)``
components of a vector field. Every other dim of the output is reduced over the
posterior draws only, never over space.

log.description: Draw log10 of the value (for counts and intensities)
log.title: Log

TemplateCatalogEntry.description:
A plugin workflow template (entry-point group ``mapi.workflow_templates``).

The sibling of :class:`~mapi_spec.workflow_templates.WorkflowTemplate` (which this module
cannot import: ``workflow`` imports the catalog). The id is ``<namespace>_<name>`` so it
fits ``POST /v1/workflows {template}``; ``document`` is the workflow document, validated
against the merged node contracts when the control plane loads the catalog.
